name: Ziema's Disappearance
text:
My dreams are still haunted by the night we lost Ziema Adya.

Three days from the mountains, shadowy figures descended upon us. We thought them bandits. We were wrong. They did not come to rob us or kill us—they came for Ziema.

She fought fiercely, saving many of our lives, but in the chaos they seized her. Some of our most experienced warriors vanished with her.

For so long I have wondered who took her, and why. Now we have found traces of them here, in these wild lands.

I will find Ziema.

And I will have my vengeance on those who stole her away.

She is located in a Barbarian encampment.

name: Ziema's Awakening
text: Your search has finally led you to a Forgotten warrior. She calls herself Ziema Adya. She offers her service, but in what capacity?
